title: Rome Demands the End of Carthage
hook: Part 9. Rome’s patience ends in the Senate—now only fire and steel remain.
full_narration: Part 9. Rome’s patience ends in the Senate—now only fire and steel remain. In the marble halls of Rome, voices rise, cold and relentless. [[pause:0.4]] The Senate finds its reason—Carthage must die. Messengers cross the sea, bringing Rome’s demand to Carthage’s gates. [[voice:tense]] Panic sweeps the city—families gather what little hope remains. From every rooftop, the people watch Roman ships darken the horizon. [[pause:0.6]] Carthaginian defenders arm themselves, shadows flickering in torchlight. Scipio Aemilianus, young and unyielding, leads Rome’s legions across the waves. The Roman camps encircle Carthage—walls tightening like a fist. [[voice:low]] Night falls, and the city’s heart beats with dread. The siege begins—drums echo through the darkness, hope slipping away. Carthage’s defenders prepare for the final siege. The city’s fate will be written in the coming darkness. [[pause:0.8]] Follow for part 10.

youtube_description: Rome’s patience has ended. In this episode, the Roman Senate finally finds its reason—Carthage must be destroyed. Messengers cross the sea, panic sweeps the city, and Carthage’s defenders brace for war. Scipio Aemilianus leads the Roman legions as the siege begins, surrounding the city in darkness. The Third Punic War erupts, and the fate of Carthage hangs by a thread. Watch as the final siege prepares to write the last chapter of a civilization. The end is coming. Follow for part 10.
